sections.body: Everyone in a family can help! 🏠
You can tidy your toys, put clothes in the basket and help set the table.
Helping makes you feel proud and big! 💪
Choose one job to do today, like putting your shoes away.
Small, regular jobs build responsibility. Praise effort, not perfection.

quiz.q: Playtime is over. What can you do with your toys?
hints: Putting things back keeps the room nice.
After lunch we put our plate away. After playing we put toys…?
quiz.explain: Tidying toys away is a great way to help! 🧸

quiz.q: Which job can a little helper do?
options: Put socks in the laundry basket 🧺
hints: Which one is safe for a little helper?
Two of these are only for grown-ups.
Watering a plant is a good kid job. Which one here is like that?
quiz.explain: Putting socks in the basket is a great job for you! 🧺
